children: Visitor arrivals to New Zealand climbed 8.0% year-on-year to 248,714 in August 2026, slowing from an 8.5% rise in July and marking the smallest growth in three months.
Arrivals from China increased by 6,500, followed by Australia (up 5,800), the US (up 2,000), and Malaysia (up 1,300).
There were record arrivals for an August month of overseas visitors from some markets, including Australia (125,600), Taiwan (5,800), and Singapore (4,600).
Overall, overseas visitor arrivals reached 99% of pre-pandemic levels, compared with 251,100 in August 2019.

Australians remained the largest source of visitors, accounting for 51% of the total, followed by China (11%), the US (6%), and Japan (4%), highlighting the continued recovery in international tourism demand.

title: New Zealand Tourist Arrivals Rise Least in 3 Months
